## Meet Michael
Michael Gates is a husband, father of five, and an experienced and accomplished trial attorney who, as Huntington Beach’s City Attorney, started a criminal prosecutor program in the city, defended police officers in court and won, defended medical doctors in court and won, and has fought Sacramento bureaucrats and won. Now, he will aggressively fight for all Californians as our next Attorney General.
### Accomplished Trial Attorney
### Winning Defending Police Officers
### Successful in Fighting Crime & Homelessness
### Known as Fighter for the People
Learn More
###### Support GATES
## Donate Today!
This campaign is fueled by people like you who are fed up with living in fear, who are tired of their family’s safety in the hands of selfish politicians, and are ready for a new era of leadership who is ready to crack down on the lawlessness across our state.
